Prevention: Before planting dip disease free suckers in 1% carbendazim in case there is some disease present
It is not possible to stop the disease within a plant but drenching of carbendazim 0.2% solution at 2
3 litre/ plant in the soil around the plants at monthly intervals starting from 1st month of planting may help to prevent it spreading to new nearby plants.
Monitoring: Fallow crop rotation, avoid banana planting for 3-4 years in the affected field may help but will not avoid the problem
Flooding of field for 2-3 months to kill the disease inoculum (pathogen).
Use disinfectant on farm implements, knives etc.
Excessive rrigation water can the spread of the fungus.

Observe the early symptom which is yellowing of lower leaves, including leaf blades and petioles.
The older leaves turn yellow and collapse.
The leaves hang around the pseudostem and wither.
Advanced stages of disease shows plants with a spiky appearance due to prominent upright apical leaves.
The insides of the stem will turn reddish brown as the fungus grows through the plant
The stem may split deeply especially during fruiting.
Direct Control: Uprooting and destroying infected plant with root and suckers as soon as symptoms appear.
Do not spread the disease by spreading the diseased plant material.
Provide good drainage especially during rainy season and use organic soil amendments.
Restrictions: U (Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use).
Very toxic to the aquatic organisms.
Therefore cultivation besides water reservoirs should not be soil drenched.
